name: @fixture/decorator-fullstack
$comment: This fixture had NO manifest until 2026-08-13 (backlog B-M67-21), although
`pnpm-workspace.yaml` listed it as a member — pnpm silently ignores a directory without one.
So nothing linked `@theokit/http` here, and the SWC loader writes a `.__decorated__.mjs` next to
the controller and imports it: that file's `import '@theokit/http'` had nothing to resolve
against. Vitest 3 hid it, because Vite's resolver answered from the repo's aliases; vitest 4 uses
Node's own runner for an emitted `.mjs`, and the import failed with `Cannot find package`.
Declaring what the fixture consumes is the fix. The same class as the undeclared `pg` in the
Postgres integration test: a consumer that does not declare its dependency works only where
something else happens to provide it.
